smoke.directInvocation: opencode run --agent explore -- 'Find the definition of validateBudgetMetadata and return file_path:line_number.'

failureSignals: agent reports missing read, grep, glob, list, or lsp permission
agent attempts to invoke webfetch (which is not in explore's budget)
agent attempts edit/write and reports it is not permitted
passCriteria: response returns `scripts/subagent-context-budget.js:<line>` where <line> is the line containing `function validateBudgetMetadata`
response cites whether LSP goToDefinition, grep, or read was used to find it
no file write or edit is attempted
expectations.skippedUnbudgeted: smoke runner emits skipped-unbudgeted without invoking the agent when explore.state.kind == 'unbudgeted'.

nonInteractive.details: explore's budget has no ask rules; read, glob, grep, list, lsp, todowrite, question, skill are all allow. The smoke prompt never needs webfetch or any mutation tool.

smoke.representativeTask: Locate the definition of `validateBudgetMetadata` in this repository and return its file path with line number using LSP or grep.

smoke.directInvocation: opencode run --agent general -- 'Summarise the README contributing section and identify one documentation gap. Cite headings; at most one webfetch.'

failureSignals: agent reports missing read or webfetch permission
agent attempts edit, write, or bash and reports it is not permitted
agent stalls awaiting a permission prompt
passCriteria: response cites a specific README heading present in README.md
response names at least one documentation gap with a one-sentence justification
response lists each tool the agent invoked (read, glob, grep, webfetch, lsp)
expectations.skippedUnbudgeted: smoke runner emits skipped-unbudgeted without invoking the agent when general.state.kind == 'unbudgeted'; ValidationComparator records the skip and only fails the run if the smoke result was required.

nonInteractive.details: Every tool the smoke task needs (read, glob, grep, list, webfetch, lsp, todowrite, question, skill) is an allow rule on the general budget; the smoke prompt never invokes a tool outside that set.

smoke.representativeTask: Summarise the contributing-section of this repository's top-level README and identify one documentation gap, citing the README heading and (optionally) one upstream documentation URL fetched via webfetch.
